title: Documentation-repo doc set and register (WowAddonStandards, dev-copilot)
cluster_summary: Root cause: the two documentation-and-tooling repos still describe themselves as they were before documentation-§8. That section applies audit-review-history unchanged and requires a five-section docs/ARCHITECTURE.md hub. As a result WAS prose forbids its own docs/audits/ and docs/reviews/ stores, dev-copilot has no hub, map or register, and dev-copilot's audit agent prompt (agents/wow-standards-audit.md:82) states that neither repo has a hub, so every documentation-lane run skips the real register. The fix needs one change in each repo. In WAS, one commit landing with this cycle's bundles rewrites the six contradicting passages (CLAUDE.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, README.md), adds the two map rows and drops the hard file count. In dev-copilot, one commit authors docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (Overview, Module Map, Known Limitations, Documentation map, Documented deviations) and fixes the agent prompt: line 82 plus the stale *.sh-only, 'expected to fail' and 'rungs (a) and (b)' content. DC-A-04 is refuted, and WAS-A-19 is informational only.

verdicts.assessment: Verified. CLAUDE.md:11, :61-62 and :107-110, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:23-24, and README.md:17 and :154-155 all say audits or reviews are never stored in this repo. That contradicts documentation-§8, which applies audit-review-history unchanged, and it contradicts this cycle's own bundles. The finding overcounts: it spans six files, not seven. AUDIT.md:3-6, standards/README.md:5-6 and ADDONS.md:5-7/:80-81 talk about addons' audits and are accurate as written.
verdicts.remediation: In the commit that adds this cycle's docs/audits/2026-10-07/ and docs/reviews/ bundles, rewrite CLAUDE.md:11-15, :61-62 and :107-110, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:23-24, and README.md:17-18 and :154-155. The new text says that addons audit themselves in their own repos, and that this repo keeps its own documentation-lane docs/audits/<date>/ and docs/reviews/<date>/ stores (documentation-§8, audit-review-history). Optionally add a one-clause qualifier to AUDIT.md:3-6, standards/README.md:5-6 and ADDONS.md:80-81. Fold WAS-A-02 and WAS-A-03 into the same commit.

verdicts.assessment: The map at docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:69 claims every .md file has a row, but it names neither docs/audits/ nor docs/reviews/. documentation-§3 requires frozen stores to be named once each as directories. The gap opens as soon as the bundles are committed.
verdicts.remediation: Add one directory row each for docs/audits/<date>/ and docs/reviews/<date>/ (frozen stores), modelled on the harvests/<date>/ row, in the WAS-A-01 commit.

verdicts.assessment: DEPENDENCIES.md:14 hard-codes '67 tracked files: 63 Markdown'. That is true today and becomes false the moment the bundles are committed, which breaks documentation-§5 sync. The fix is trivial.
verdicts.remediation: Drop the count, or restate the line by kind: 'Markdown only, plus LICENSE, .gitattributes and two logo images'. Do this in the WAS-A-01 commit.

verdicts.assessment: An informational row. A register entry of 'None.' is correct, and the will-not-do issues decline proposals rather than depart from rules.

Verified in dev-copilot/agents/wow-standards-audit.md. Line 343 check (c) names only *.sh. Lines 218-219 still say the check 'is expected to fail' and cite '11 of 11 addons failing it'. Line 278 cites the retired launcher 'rungs (a) and (b)'. The fix belongs in dev-copilot, not WAS. Because the prompt steers every future audit, the severity is low rather than info.
verdicts.remediation: In the same dev-copilot commit as DC-A-05, edit agents/wow-standards-audit.md: add *.py text eol=lf beside *.sh in check (c) at :343, drop 'expected to fail' and '11 of 11' at :218-219, and replace 'rungs (a) and (b)' at :278 with the current launcher-§2 click behavior.

verdicts.assessment: documentation-§8 Substitutes #3 is a MUST, and dev-copilot/docs holds only superpowers/ (plus this cycle's untracked audits/ and reviews/), with no ARCHITECTURE.md. This is the root of DC-A-02, DC-A-03 and DC-A-05.
verdicts.remediation: Author docs/ARCHITECTURE.md with exactly five sections: Overview, Module Map, Known Limitations, ## Documentation map and ## Documented deviations. Move the file-and-path map from CLAUDE.md:21-40 into it, leaving a pointer behind. Name the path-addressed surfaces whose rename would break callers: bin/ names, hooks.json script paths, profiles/wow/<name>.md and the ka0s-bounded path. Update CLAUDE.md:38 and :119 to reference the hub. DC-A-02 and DC-A-03 land in the same commit.

verdicts.assessment: This finding depends on DC-A-01: without a hub there is no deviation register. It is not a separate work item.
verdicts.remediation: Fold into DC-A-01: add a ## Documented deviations heading reading 'None.' unless a decline (for example DC-12) is ratified there.

verdicts.assessment: The gap is real but the proposed remediation is incomplete. It omits docs/reviews/, which dev-copilot will hold once this cycle's bundles are committed. It also leaves out the root .md files and the commands/agents/profiles trees, which the map must cover or explicitly scope out.
verdicts.remediation: Fold into DC-A-01. In the Documentation map, name docs/superpowers/, docs/audits/ and docs/reviews/ once each as frozen stores. Register README.md, CLAUDE.md, DEPENDENCIES.md and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md. Then either register the commands/, agents/ and profiles/ .md trees as directory rows or state the map's scope explicitly.

verdicts.assessment: documentation-§8 asks for the re-read outcome to be recorded but names no location, and the Lua trigger has not fired because dev-copilot tracks no .lua files. DEPENDENCIES.md:84-95 already records the outcome explicitly: Lua, luacheck and lizard are not used here, and the Python and shell scripts are on no complexity gate. The rule is met.

Verified at agents/wow-standards-audit.md:81-82: 'neither repo has a docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, so the ratified-decision register is the root CLAUDE.md...'. That is false for WAS, whose hub carries ## Documented deviations, and it contradicts §8 Substitutes #3. Every future documentation-lane audit is misdirected away from the real register, so the error repeats on each run.
verdicts.remediation: Rewrite :80-86 so the documentation-lane register is docs/ARCHITECTURE.md § ## Documented deviations in both repos, with a missing hub reported as a documentation-§8 finding, and keep the repo's GitHub issue store as the second input. Done when grep 'neither repo has a' over agents/ returns nothing. Ship it in the same commit as DC-A-01 and WAS-A-20.
